Jasmine / Laura — quick heads-up from legal: Exhibit F as a schedule is fine to enumerate multiple invoice recipients, but we should add a short MSA clarification clause that allows billing to be directed to alternate invoice recipients per Exhibit(s). I suggest the following language for minimal friction: 

"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the MSA, charges described in Exhibit F may be invoiced to the invoice-lane(s) and cost centers expressly identified in Exhibit F, and Customer represents it has the authority to designate such invoice recipients."

If BrightPath signs off on that minimal clause, we can avoid broader MSA edits. Attaching a redline that inserts that clause and the lane table.
